create_DataPackage: create a DataPackage instance to wrap and manage a set of prompts with correct and incorrect answers
build_load_from_filepath: build a DataPackage by loading prompts and answers from a JSONL file with specified field names
run_load_and_prepare: run load_and_prepare to load data from a task string, JSON results file, or folder with optional shuffling and capping
test_shuffle_data: test shuffling DataPackage data with a random seed while preserving prompt-answer correspondence
review_load_from_results_json: review loading prompts from a saved results JSON file, falling back to default custom prompts on failure
